title: rollout
description: Fact row: one unit of COMPUTE. kind='rollout' is one inner M0+H2 search and carries a score; the other kinds carry compute with no score so that the total closes. This is the x-axis of a performance-vs-compute plot.

kind.description: summing compute over ONLY kind=rollout undercounts the true cost

k.description: candidate index within the GRPO group

run_idx.description: distinguishes repeated runs of one candidate under a cascade

stage.description: cascade stage; take argmax over stages for SCORE, sum for COMPUTE

best_score.description: combined scale; argmax over this candidate's steps

best_metrics.description: raw evaluator metrics at the best step

base_score.description: the score this candidate was measured against (reward baseline)

compute.description: null means NOT MEASURED. Never write 0 for something that was not metered.

evaluator_calls.description: budgeted full evaluations; excludes the refunded seed eval

probe_calls.description: subsampled, off-budget — cheap but not free

compute_flags.description: per-field provenance for compute; any field that is null MUST have a flag here

spec_hash.description: content address of the H2 genome — the identity of this harness variant

artifact_path.description: cluster path this row was parsed from
